## 1.3.23 (HexGhoul): Ken's kakugan iris fixed (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.23 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 63**, same as 1.3.21 and 1.3.22). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, not tried in game.

- **Ken's kakugan looks like an eye now.** His eyes were read sideways when the textures were made, so the kakugan was a red bar on top of a black bar. Now it follows the eye he's drawn with: a red iris (deep red under the lid, brighter below) where his grey iris is, a black sclera where the white is, his lash line kept above it, and the veins at the outer corner. His glowing iris matches.
